_comment: Every image slot in the folio and the production items. Sizes are the printed slot in mm. scripts/make_placeholder_plates.py writes one SVG per entry; real artwork replaces a placeholder by keeping the filename. 'source' records where each image came from; the folio pages present every slot as the finished item it stands for.
